name: Patient A (synthetic): heart failure
summary: DISCHARGE SUMMARY. Dx: Acute decompensated HFrEF (EF 30%), resolved with IV diuresis. Medications: CONTINUE furosemide 40 mg PO daily. CONTINUE warfarin 5 mg PO daily; INR check in 3 days. START ibuprofen 400 mg PO q8h PRN for knee pain. START amoxicillin 500 mg PO TID x 7 days for dental infection. START metoprolol succinate 25 mg PO daily. Diet: 2 g sodium restriction; fluid limit 1.5 L/day. Weigh daily each morning. Follow-up: cardiology clinic in 7 days; primary care in 14 days. Return precautions: weight gain >3 lb in 24 h or >5 lb in a week, worsening dyspnea, orthopnea, chest pain or syncope. Call 911 for chest pain or syncope.

name: Patient B (synthetic): pneumonia + COPD
summary: DISCHARGE SUMMARY. Dx: Community-acquired pneumonia with COPD exacerbation. Medications: CONTINUE lisinopril 10 mg PO daily. CONTINUE potassium chloride 20 mEq PO daily. CONTINUE albuterol inhaler 2 puffs q4-6h PRN. START spironolactone 25 mg PO daily for fluid retention. START levalbuterol inhaler 2 puffs q4h PRN wheeze. START prednisone 40 mg PO daily x 5 days. START azithromycin 250 mg PO daily x 4 more days. Activity: walk short distances, rest as needed; no smoking. Follow-up: primary care in 5 days; pulmonology in 3 weeks; repeat chest X-ray in 6 weeks. Return precautions: fever above 101 F, worsening shortness of breath, coughing blood, or lips turning blue. Call 911 for blue lips or severe breathlessness; call the clinic for fever.
